title: Injective effacement gives a right exact pullback ladder
statement: Let i:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and r a natural number. Let U send module-valued etale sheaves on X to abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and V=i^* on abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume H^n(Y,U(i^*I)) is trivial for every injective module-valued sheaf I on X and every n>0 [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For every module sheaf M and q≥0, there exist module sheaves J,Q, a map g:J→Q, and additive maps δX:H^q(X,U(Q))→H^{q+1}(X,U(M)) and δY:H^q(Y,VU(Q))→H^{q+1}(Y,VU(M)). The sequences H^q(U(J))→H^q(U(Q))→H^{q+1}(U(M))→0 and H^q(VU(J))→H^q(VU(Q))→H^{q+1}(VU(M))→0 are right exact, where the first maps are induced by U(g) and VU(g). The boundary square commutes with the canonical cohomology pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. There is no global-sections comparison assumption.

proof.text: Use the existing Grothendieck-abelian and enough-injectives instances for the actual module-valued sheaf category. Set J = Injective.under M, use Injective.ι M, and let Q be its cokernel and g the quotient. ShortComplex.exact_cokernel and ShortExact.mk' give the short exact sequence.

The proved private helper exactForget shows coefficient forgetting preserves finite limits and colimits. For limits, compose with the fully faithful inclusion in presheaves and reflect the preserved limits. For colimits, ModuleCat.forget₂PreservesColimitsOfSize and sheafComposeNatIso identify the composite with sheafification with a colimit-preserving functor; Adjunction.preservesColimitsOfSize_iff descends preservation across the reflective sheafification adjunction. Thus ShortExact.map_of_exact gives the forgotten short exact sequence. Apply pullbackCohomology_longExact_ladder to obtain both exact sequences and the canonical boundary square.

Apply moduleValued_injective_cohomology_comparison to J. Its injective constant-ring module representative has zero positive right-derived abelian evaluation by isZero_rightDerived_etale_toSheaf_of_injective, with base coefficient ring ULift ZMod(r). Transport this vanishing through the supplied additive equivalence to H^(q+1)(U(J)). Apply pullback_forget_modules_iso and the given acyclicity assumption to kill H^(q+1)(VU(J)); functoriality of H makes the induced map from the isomorphism injective.

Exactness at H^(q+1)(U(M)) and H^(q+1)(VU(M)), with zero target under each following map, gives a preimage of every class. Therefore both connecting homomorphisms are surjective. Specialize the ladder boundary identity to q and apply AddMonoidHom.ext. Only q+1 > 0 is used, covering q = 0.

theorem Etale.exists_module_acyclic_effacement_ladder
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ X) (r : ℕ)
    (hacyclic : ∀ (J : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) [Injective J]
        (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
        ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
            ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))].obj J)) q))
    (M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) (q : ℕ) :
    let U := sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    let V := (i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    ∃ (J Q : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) (g : J ⟶ Q),
    ∃ δX : Sheaf.H (U.obj Q) q →+ Sheaf.H (U.obj M) (q + 1),
    ∃ δY : Sheaf.H (V.obj (U.obj Q)) q →+ Sheaf.H (V.obj (U.obj M)) (q + 1),
      Function.Exact (Sheaf.H.map (U.map g) q) δX ∧
      Function.Exact (Sheaf.H.map (V.map (U.map g)) q) δY ∧
      Function.Surjective δX ∧ Function.Surjective δY ∧
      δY.comp (cohomologyMap i (U.obj Q) q) =
        (cohomologyMap i (U.obj M) (q + 1)).comp δX
